usedFor: Razorpay holds your payments, and ApexVerify checks contact details when “Payment Fails” runs “Verify Email or Phone”.

bestTemplate.name: “Payment Fails” in Razorpay, then “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify
bestTemplate.why: A failed payment checks whether the payer’s email or phone is real before anyone follows up.

watchOut: “Verify Email or Phone” needs a verification type and target country, so set both in the template.
